title: The Space Eaters: Cosmic Horror Unleashed
author: Frank Belknap Long
description:
When a mysterious force from beyond the solar system descends upon Earth, the fabric of reality begins to unravel. In "Space-Eaters," Frank Belknap Long introduces listeners to a chilling tale that intertwines cosmic horror with profound existential dread. As humanity grapples with this unprecedented threat, a group of scientists and ordinary citizens must confront their greatest fears and probe the unknown. What lurks in the shadows of the universe, and what is its insatiable hunger?

Throughout this gripping audiobook, listeners will follow the harrowing journey of these characters as they uncover the truth behind the bizarre occurrences plaguing their world. Each discovery leads them deeper into a labyrinth of terror, where the lines between sanity and madness blur. The stakes escalate as they face not just an external menace, but also the darker aspects of human nature.

With vivid imagery and a relentless pace, Long crafts a narrative that keeps you on the edge of your seat. This isn’t just a story about an alien threat; it’s a profound exploration of fear, survival, and the unknown. As the characters confront the Space-Eaters, they challenge the very essence of existence itself. Will they find a way to combat this cosmic horror, or will they become prey to its unyielding appetite? title: Fall Asleep to Batman Stories
author: Sabin Mainali
description:
Gotham City feels different at night.

The streets grow quieter, the skyline disappears into darkness, and somewhere above the city, Batman continues a mission that has defined him for generations.

In this collection, we’re slowing things down and exploring Batman stories to fall asleep to—from mysterious detective cases and forgotten adventures to emotional character stories, disturbing villains, hidden Gotham lore, and some of the most memorable moments in the Dark Knight’s history.

We’ll journey through Bruce Wayne’s transformation into Batman, his relationship with Alfred and the Bat-Family, his greatest investigations, and his endless battles against villains like the Joker, Riddler, Scarecrow, Two-Face, Bane, Ra’s al Ghul, and many more.

Along the way, we’ll explore the quieter side of Batman too—the loneliness behind the mask, the sacrifices Bruce makes for Gotham, the people he has lost, and the rare moments when the man beneath the cape begins to emerge.

Why does Bruce continue being Batman after everything it has cost him?

Which cases truly tested the World’s Greatest Detective?

And after spending his entire life fighting Gotham’s darkness, can Bruce Wayne ever finally find peace?

Some stories are mysterious. Some are heartbreaking. Some are surprisingly disturbing. And others remind us why Batman has remained one of fiction’s greatest characters for generations.

This collection is made for late-night listening, relaxing, studying, background listening, or slowly drifting off while exploring the dark streets of Gotham City.

So dim the lights, get comfortable, close your eyes, and let’s disappear into the world of Batman stories.

Welcome back to the StoriesofGames Network.

title: The Friday Fuel Podcast
author: Doc and Ray
description:
FRIDAY FUEL IS HERE! 🔥🚛

Doc and Ray are joined by special guest Wideglide, a veteran owner-operator, for a straight-up conversation about one of the toughest realities in trucking: the 80% owner-operator failure rate.

Why do so many drivers make the jump from company driver to owner-operator only to end up back behind the wheel for someone else—or out of trucking altogether?

Is it the cost of the truck? Fuel? Maintenance? Insurance? Freight rates? Poor business decisions? Not knowing your numbers? Or are drivers simply being sold the dream without being prepared for what comes with owning the business?

On this episode of Friday Fuel, Doc, Ray and Wideglide break down what they're seeing in the industry, what owner-operators need to understand before taking the leap, and what separates the ones who survive from the ones who don't.

This isn't about discouraging drivers from becoming owner-operators. It's about knowing what you're getting into before you sign on the dotted line.

🔥 FRIDAY FUEL — What's on your rate con, DRIVERRRR?

Drop your thoughts in the comments: Why do you think so many owner-operators fail?

title: The Isobar
author: Fox Audio Network
description:
Dive deep into the fascinating, complex, and sometimes devastating world of weather with "The Isobar: The Highs and Lows of Meteorology." This science-driven podcast is hosted by Rob Haswell (Fox Milwaukee), joined by fellow Fox Chief Meteorologists Emily Wahls (Fox Chicago), Rich Luterman (Fox Detroit), and other expert weather guests.


Together, this formidable team leverages their combined decades of experience forecasting for the challenging Midwestern climate.


In each episode, we explore:

-The Severe Stuff: How major weather events unfold, from devastating tornadoes to the mechanics of flash floods and elusive water spouts. We analyze recent storms and their real-world impact on communities.

-Deep Weather Forecasting: We go beyond the 7-day outlook. Get in-depth analysis of evolving weather patterns and exclusive long-range temperature and precipitation forecasts you won’t find elsewhere.

-Science, Lore & History: Uncover the captivating history of meteorology, separate weather lore from scientific fact, and understand the historical context of major climate events.


"The Isobar" is for the curious minds - the science nerds, weather enthusiasts, and anyone who looks at the sky and wants to know why it's doing that. Our tone is professional and educational yet deeply conversational, allowing the personalities of our veteran meteorologists to shine through, even when the topic gets lighter.


Join Rob, Emily, Rich, and their colleagues as they decode the atmosphere. "The Isobar: The Highs and Lows of Meteorology" - listen and understand the weather like never before.

author: Druhé Dveře
description:
Co když problém není v tom, že neznáme odpověď, ale že jsme si ještě nevšimli jiné možnosti?

Druhé dveře jsou český podcast o psychologii, rozhodování, vztazích, změně, práci a osobním rozvoji. Vychází z vědeckých studií a psychologického výzkumu a převádí jejich poznatky do situací, které známe z běžného života.

Proč se někdy zasekneme? Jak se rozhodujeme, když nevíme, co je správně? Co ovlivňuje naše vztahy, důvěru nebo spolupráci s druhými? Proč některé změny vydrží a jiné ne? A co nám může pomoci všimnout si možnosti, kterou jsme předtím neviděli?

Každá epizoda začíná konkrétním výzkumem nebo psychologickým principem. Jednoduše si vysvětlíme, co vědci zjistili, kde má jejich výzkum své hranice a co z něj můžeme a nemůžeme přenést do rozhodování, vztahů, práce a každodenního života.

Nejde o hledání dalšího univerzálního návodu. Někdy může být užitečnější položit jinou otázku, všimnout si něčeho, co jsme přehlíželi, nebo se na známou situaci podívat z jiné strany.

Výzkum tu není jako návod. Je to způsob, jak otevřít další možnost.

Bez rychlých receptů. Bez motivačních pouček. Psychologie, vědecký výzkum a nové pohledy na situace, které známe všichni.

Protože někdy nepotřebujeme další odpověď.

Možná potřebujeme objevit druhé dveře.

title: Divine Whisper Tribe
author: Dr. Don R. Kelly
description:
The path to spiritual understanding is rarely a straight line. It's a winding road, full of unexpected turns and moments of profound clarity interwoven with periods of doubt and uncertainty. For many years, I sought answers in the grand pronouncements of religious dogma and philosophical treatises. Yet, the most transformative guidance I have ever received has not come through thunderous pronouncements but through the quiet whispers of intuition, the gentle nudges of the heart, and the subtle synchronicities that seemed to weave themselves into the fabric of my daily life. These quiet moments, these intimate communications with the divine, are the essence of this book. In "Divine Whispers Messages from God," I aim to share my journey and the journey of others, recognizing and interpreting these subtle signs through this podcast. This isn't a theoretical exploration; it's a practical guide born from personal experiences. It's a journey of self-discovery, a testament to the power of listening, and an invitation to cultivate a deeper connection with the inherent wisdom that lives within each of us. Within the pages of the books and this podcast you will find practical personal anecdotes designed to help you hone your intuitive abilities and develop a trusting relationship with the divine guidance that awaits you. 
We will dig into this intimate communication, examining its characteristics and how to cultivate the receptivity needed to discern it from the noise of everyday life. Through personal stories, spiritual practices, theoretical perspectives, and practical clinical advice, "Divine Whisper Messages from God", Divine Whisper Fruit of the Spirit, and this podcast will give you the tools to deepen your spiritual connection and enhance your ability to receive and interpret divine guidance. Whether you are a seasoned spiritual practitioner or a curious newcomer on this path, these books and podcasts offer a unique blend of personal and practical narratives designed to empower you to listen more deeply to the quiet wisdom within and the boundless love surrounding you. Prepare to listen—the Divine is whispering. Prepare to embark on a journey of self-discovery as we explore together the subtle art of listening to the “Divine Whisper.”

title: EJO Invitational Podcast

description:

Hosted and produced by Lou Temlett of JIU JITSU LOU, the podcast introduces the grapplers stepping onto the EJO Invitational mats and gives you the chance to get to know the people behind the match-ups.

Rooted in Faith is a Christian podcast that inspires and encourages you to grow deeper in your relationship with God.

Play the Word while you go about your day—let Scripture fill the atmosphere of your home, strengthen your faith and draw you closer to God. 	•	feel invisible after 50

	•	want more life, not less
	•	are curious about travel

author: idobi Network

Bringing the same authenticity, humor, and passion that have made her a standout talent and beloved figure among fans, Bailey creates a space for candid, engaging discussions that feel both personal and relatable.

title: BEHIND THE NUMBER
author: Lähtokohta podcast
description:
BEHIND THE NUMBER is an ongoing English-language slow-burn psychological audio mystery from Finland. 
Ordinary places begin to feel unfamiliar as times, numbers, fragments of conversation, silence and recurring sounds form a larger pattern.

author: Emily Moore
description:
The Profitable Practice is a podcast for accountants who want to build firms that are profitable, sustainable, and worth owning.


Hosted by Emily Moore, owner of Bean Countery, each episode explores the real work of entrepreneurship: pricing, clients, systems, people, profit, leadership, and the decisions that turn accounting skills into a thriving business.


Along the way, we’ll talk openly about capitalism, free markets, and the incredible opportunity accountants have to create value, build wealth, serve businesses, and participate boldly in the economy.

You already know how to do the accounting. The Profitable Practice is about building the business.

title: Fashion Talks With PlusSizeVixen
author: PlusSize Vixen
description: Fashion Talks with PlusSizeVixen is where fashion, beauty, confidence, and real-life conversations come together! 🎙️✨ Join PlusSizeVixen as she talks about plus-size fashion, shopping struggles, style tips, beauty, body confidence, fashion trends, and the myths we’re ready to leave behind. From faith and culture to leadership, relationships, and discipleship, nothing is off-limits at the table.
Each episode is designed to spark honest conversation, encourage spiritual growth, and help you live out your faith in everyday life. Wherever you find yourself, pull up a chair—you’re invited to the table.

title: Ordinary Things
author: Created with Purpose Ministries
description:
Most Christian podcasts are built around sermons or interviews. Ordinary Things is neither. Instead, think of this as twenty minutes with a friend over coffee.

 

Every Tuesday, we'll begin with an ordinary moment and discover the extraordinary God who was in it all along. Here, you'll learn to recognize God's presence in the middle of your own story. Through heartfelt storytelling, biblical truth, and everyday life, I'll help you discover that the moments we easily overlook are often the very places where God leaves His fingerprints.

 

Maybe you're driving to chemotherapy. Maybe you're sitting in a parking lot after receiving difficult news. Maybe you're overwhelmed caring for an aging parent. Maybe you've just lost a job, buried someone you love, or life simply hasn't turned out the way you hoped.


Whatever brought you here, I'm so glad you found your way.

 

I'm Kimberly Morrison—author, speaker, and founder of Created with Purpose Ministries. For years, God has been teaching me to see His extraordinary work in life's most ordinary moments, and I can't wait to share those stories with you. More than anything, I hope this podcast ministers to you and serves as a weekly reminder that God is faithfully weaving purpose into even the most ordinary moments of your life.

 

So every Tuesday, pull up a chair, pour yourself a cup of coffee, and let's discover God's fingerprints together. Because once you learn to recognize God in the ordinary... you'll begin to see Him everywhere.

The Risk Takerz is a show/platform that explores money, relationships, fitness, communication, personal growth, human behavior, and the everyday decisions that shape our lives. Every episode is a real, unfiltered conversation designed to make you think, laugh, question what you’ve been told, and most importantly taking action.
We talk about the things people are thinking, but don’t always say out loud. No perfect answers. No pretending to have it all figured out. Just honest conversations, bold opinions, real experiences, and lessons you can actually use.
If you’re willing to think differently, bet on yourself, and take a few risks along the way—you belong here.
Welcome to The Risk Takerz.

author: Ghosts 'N' That

From chilling ghost stories and eerie encounters to strange happenings that defy logic, each episode dives into the darker side of reality. Ordinary people share their extraordinary experiences—friends, neighbours, and strangers alike—bringing you authentic tales of the paranormal. title: Lobster Bob's Scenic Tours
author: Scrubbing Squad Limited
description:
Lobster Bob's Scenic Tours is the daily travel podcast for children aged 4 to 11 who would like to see the world without leaving the kitchen. Lobster Bob spent 35 years fishing off Los Roques, Venezuela, has been almost everywhere since, and got most of it wrong the first time. 

He now runs scenic tours from three vehicles: La Mula (Registration number LAM-001-VE) the four by four for Land, Nellie (Hull registration number PZ 1953 N) the boat for Sea, and El Cóndor (Tail number YV-528) the bush plane for Air. 

528 real destinations. Every fact true. Every tour earns a stamp.

A new tour every single day:
- Vehicle stories: Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
- The story behind a Bob'ism: Every Tuesday.
- Postcards from Lobster Bob: Every Thursday.
- Where in the World: A quiz on Saturday.
- Lobster Bob's Logbook: Every Sunday, where nothing happens, slowly.

Lobster Bob smells slightly of fish. He does not apologise for this.


Subscribe at lobsterbobspodcast.com for your weekly round-up and free resources.

title: The AI Skills Lab Podcast, with Future State University
author: Future State University
description:
Welcome to The AI Skills Lab, where we explore the future of learning, work, and human capability in the age of artificial intelligence.

The world of work is undergoing its most dramatic transformation in a century. AI isn't just changing what we do—it's fundamentally reshaping how we learn, how we demonstrate capability, and how we prepare for careers that don't yet exist. Traditional credentials are losing their predictive power. Employers can no longer trust that degrees and certifications translate into actual performance. Meanwhile, workers are stuck in a broken system where passive courses promise transformation but deliver forgettable content and single-digit completion rates.

The AI Skills Lab takes you inside the revolution happening at the intersection of immersive learning, artificial intelligence, and workforce development. Hosted by the team at Future State University—the world's first AI-native learning ecosystem—each episode investigates the critical questions facing educators, employers, and learners navigating this new landscape.

What makes durable skills actually durable? Why do credentials fail to predict performance? What's the difference between workers who use AI as a tool versus those trained in AI-native learning environments? And how can immersive 3D career simulations build verified capabilities at scale?

We go deep on the science of skill acquisition, the economics of talent development, and the technology making it possible to turn knowledge into applied performance. You'll hear from learning scientists, workforce strategists, technology pioneers, and practitioners building the future of human capability development.

This isn't a podcast about distant futures or abstract possibilities. Every episode explores real problems facing organizations today: the capability gap between what credentials signal and what performance requires, the transfer problem that makes most training fail, the explosion of micro-credentials that create more noise than signal, and the urgent need for learning systems that produce verified outcomes instead of vanity metrics.

Whether you're an HR leader rethinking talent development strategy, an educator questioning traditional pedagogy, a professional navigating career transitions in an AI-accelerated economy, or simply someone curious about how humans learn and grow—The AI Skills Lab gives you frameworks, evidence, and insights you can actually use.

We believe the future belongs to those who can demonstrate capability, not just claim it. To learners who practice deliberately in immersive environments, not passively consume content. To institutions that verify performance, not just award credentials. And to organizations that build skills that matter, not just check compliance boxes.

Join us in The AI Skills Lab, where theory meets practice, credentials give way to competencies, and the next generation of learning is being built in real time.

New episodes weekly. Subscribe wherever you listen to podcasts.

HarinGay Radio is a four-part podcast and soundscape amplifying queer voices, histories and communities from the north London borough of Haringey.



Inspired by the radical traditions of community radio and pirate broadcasting, the series brings together voices from across the borough through workshops, conversations and recordings with local residents, artists, activists, historians and community leaders. Blending interviews, field recordings and shared memories, HarinGay Radio creates a vibrant sound portrait of Haringey’s queer past and present.



Across four episodes, contributors explore stories that span generations—from growing up Black and gay in Finsbury Park, to women’s football, the impact of Section 28 and the energy of contemporary queer nightlife, including Tottenham’s Uhaul Dyke Rescue club nights. Drawing on Bruce Castle Museum’s collections, including the landmark children’s book Jenny Lives with Eric and Martin, the series uncovers the people, places and moments that have shaped Haringey’s significant role in LGBTQ+ history.



Part oral history, part soundscape, part community broadcast, HarinGay Radio celebrates the creativity, resilience and activism of Haringey’s LGBTQ+ communities while preserving their stories for the future.


Created by artist Ian Giles in partnership with the Haringey LGBTQ+ Community Network and supported by Mind.

title: The Podcast Effect
author: Ellen Ronalds Keene for PERK Digital
description:
What can a podcast actually do?
The Podcast Effect explores what happens when experts, organisations and ideas are given the space to be heard.
I'm Ellen Ronalds Keene, a podcast strategist, producer, educator and podcast super-listener. Through my business, PERK Digital, I've spent almost a decade producing, editing, launching and obsessing over podcasts.
And I genuinely love the audio medium. Podcasts have changed my own life since I started listening to them on my laptop in 2007. Since then, I've watched the medium grow and change, and I've become increasingly interested in what happens because a podcast exists.
The conversations it starts. The knowledge it captures. The relationships it builds. The people it reaches. The opportunities it creates.
Because podcasting offers something increasingly valuable: space, intimacy and trust.
Used deliberately, a podcast can publish expertise, build authority, preserve valuable knowledge and stories, deepen relationships and create enduring content that keeps working long after you hit publish.
In The Podcast Effect, we'll explore the strategy, economics and possibilities of podcasting — from audio versus video and the changing world of search and AI, to deep niche audiences, regional storytelling, enduring content and what meaningful podcast success actually looks like.
You'll hear solo episodes unpacking my frameworks and philosophy, alongside conversations with podcasters, producers, industry experts and people using podcasts to do genuinely interesting and valuable work.
Because your best ideas deserve more than a post or a 60-second reel.
They deserve a longer shelf life.
And a podcast doesn't need millions of listeners to make an impact. Sometimes 100 of the right listeners are more valuable than 100,000 who aren't the right audience for what you're trying to achieve.
This is The Podcast Effect.

Along the way, myths became memory, philosophy became power, and ordinary people lived through extraordinary change.In this podcast, we go beyond dates and names. We uncover the stories behind the stories.Who were the rulers that shaped history — and the forgotten voices lost beneath them? What ideas held society together — and what forces tore it apart? title: Emotional Plot
author: Sophie Liu
description:
Are the so-called "universal" emotions truly identical across the globe? Does an Ancient Greek feel the same when they φοβέομα (phobeomai, or to flee in fear) as, say, an Ancient Chinese person who 懼 (jù, or dreads and fears)? How different really is "péter un câble" (French for losing your temper or literally, bursting a cable) compared to "crash out"? 

Maybe you will find an answer to these questions in the podcast! Combining literature and psychology, this podcast examines the cultural forces that play a tremendous role in shaping how we characterize and manage our feelings. In a world of growing cultural plurality, understanding our emotions is crucial to understanding both our own identities and those of the people around us.

description:
Being a domestic abuse survivor, you learn to be oaky with your past but you never get over it. There are certain things that can trigger the past. Many say just get over it, if you never experience this then you have no room to speak. You know it’s not your fault, but still that guilt lingers. Those thoughts still linger, what could I ave done differently? Why did I do to deserve this? I may be strong on the outside, but on the inside I am lost. It took courage to share my story. What I experience and how I learned to break the chains. A survival story to help others, not just myself. Each day gets better, but it’s something I can’t forget. I would like to forget all of it, but unfortunately that will never happen.

title: COERCED: The Devotion & Death of Mica Francis Miller
author: LUNASHARK®⁠
description:
On April 27, 2024, 30-year-old Mica Francis Miller — wife of Myrtle Beach pastor John-Paul Miller — walked a mile into a North Carolina state park and made a 911 call that would be the last time the world heard her voice. Within days, her death was ruled a suicide — a ruling that would have ended the story for most true crime journalists.

We aren't most true crime journalists. And Mica's story is anything but typical.


COERCED: The Devotion & Death of Mica Francis Miller is a LUNASHARK® DROP-FEED from the award-winning team behind the Murdaugh Murders Podcast — investigative journalists Mandy Matney, Liz Farrell and Beth Braden — along with producers Kate Thomas, Grace Hills and David Moses. It’s a remastered, chronological retelling of more than 2 years of original reporting from the True Sunlight Podcast, built for listeners who want to follow one case.

Listen To Current Coverage On The True Sunlight Podcast or⁠ ⁠Ad-Free from LUNASHARK Premium on Patreon or Supercast⁠⁠ 


At the time of her death, Mica left behind a paper trail of evidence documenting how JP allegedly abused Mica emotionally, physically, sexually, medically and spiritually throughout their relationship, which started when she was a teenager and he was her youth pastor. Mica died while she was in the process of divorcing JP Miller.


COERCED takes a deeper look at JP Miller’s dark past that includes rape allegations, alleged bestiality, an assault conviction and pardon, and a pattern of allegedly abusive behavior that can be traced back to his father — Rev. Wayne Miller. JP’s felon father once owned a Christian complex in South Carolina called Gloryland… before it mysteriously burned down.  


Through exclusive interviews, 911 calls, court filings, and documents obtained through relentless FOIA requests, COERCED examines coercive control, medical and spiritual abuse, and the systems that dismissed a woman fighting for her life — and asks what accountability looks like.


Mica couldn't save herself. But her story could save others.


This series discusses domestic abuse, coercive control, and suicide. If you or someone you know needs support, please call or text 988 or contact the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233. Support in South Carolina is also available through Liza’s Lifeline.


Stay tuned. Stay pesky. And Stay in the Sunlight. ☀️

title: Ye of Little Faith: The Nature of Reality
author: Rog Phillips
description:
When Dr. Alan Sturgess, a brilliant physicist, stumbles upon a phenomenon that defies the very laws of nature, his life spirals into a whirlwind of doubt and intrigue. In "Ye of Little Faith," Rog Phillips takes listeners on a mind-bending journey through a reality where belief shapes existence. As Sturgess grapples with the implications of his discovery, he faces a chilling choice: embrace the unfathomable truths of the universe or cling to the comforting boundaries of logic.

This audiobook delves deep into the conflict between faith and reason, challenging listeners to ponder what lies beyond the tangible world. As strange occurrences unfold around him, Sturgess encounters a cast of characters who each embody different philosophies toward belief. Will he find allies in his search for understanding, or will skepticism lead him to isolation?

From the moment he uncovers the unexplainable, the stakes rise. Each twist and turn invites listeners to question their own perspectives on reality. Packed with rich ideas and philosophical dilemmas, "Ye of Little Faith" explores the nature of existence and the power of belief in a way that resonates long after the final chapter.

Join Dr. Sturgess as he embarks on a quest that merges science fiction with profound existential questions. Discover how the universe bends and twists around faith, and why sometimes, believing is the first step to uncovering the truth.

title: Seven Footprints to Satan: A Thrilling Quest for Power
author: Abraham Merritt
description:
When the mysterious Stranger offers a perilous challenge, the stakes are higher than anyone could imagine—one wrong step means a service to Satan, but four right steps could unlock unimaginable wealth. In "Seven Footprints to Satan," author Abraham Merritt takes listeners on a thrilling journey where every decision can lead to salvation or doom. Explore the dark underbelly of temptation as characters grapple with their deepest fears and desires, navigating a labyrinthine path filled with sinister secrets.

This action-packed adventure follows a group of daring souls who must confront the ultimate moral dilemma: will they risk everything for power, or choose the safer, but less rewarding, path? As they inch closer to Satan's black throne, the tension mounts, and alliances are tested. Who can be trusted, and who will betray them when faced with the lure of eternal servitude?

Filled with vivid imagery and heart-pounding suspense, this audiobook invites listeners to ponder the cost of ambition and the nature of evil. With each step, the question looms larger: how far would you go to claim your destiny? Join this gripping exploration of choice, consequence, and the shadows lurking just beyond the light. Will you dare to follow the footprints to your fate?

title: Michael Shultz's Sermons and Lectures
author: hmichaelshultzjr
description: This is a digital library of the collected sermons and lectures of H. Michael Shultz Jr.

title: In the balance by Chrystal Marie
author: Chrystal Marie
description:
In the Balance by Chrystal Marie
Every case has two sides: what was believed, and what can be proven. Between evidence and assumption, certainty and doubt, sits the place where justice is decided. That place is In the Balance.
Introducing Series One: Convicted by Teeth.
A mark on skin. A photograph. An expert opinion. A courtroom. A verdict. But what happens when evidence once trusted to answer the question of guilt is later challenged by new scientific understanding? This 11-part documentary series follows the journey of bite-mark analysis through the criminal justice system.

title: The 14th take
author: Kiana
description:
The 14th Take 🎬

A little corner for everyday thoughts, books, movies, filmmaking, and all the random things I discover along the way.

I’m a 14-year-old reader, filmmaker, director, and ENFP, sharing life as I see it—one thought, one story, and one take at a time.

Welcome to the 14th take.

title: Lightside Collectibles
author: David W. Carr
description: Lightside Collectibles is where the galaxy far, far away meets the thrill of the hunt. Hosts David Carr and Roger Jorns dig into Star Wars and pop culture collecting — vintage finds, grail hunts, market trends, booth and convention stories, and the real economics of turning a passion for collecting into something sustainable. Whether you're chasing your next holy grail or just love hearing what's out there, pull up a seat at the case.

title: Just a little movie recap
author: Ari Sela
description: Grab the popcorn and join us for Just a Little Movie recap, a fun father-daughter podcast where we revisit movies that my daughter has watched, recap its biggest moments and answer any fan questions. Every episode is a relaxed small conversation about the movie (it goes our of rails fast!), what we liked and didn't like. Whether you've seen the movie or just want the (very brief) highlights, you're invited to join the fun!

title: Gigi’s Gift
author: Carmela Fazio
description: Gigi’s Gift is a podcast about special-needs parenting, education, advocacy, and the real-life journey of raising a child with disabilities. It shares honest stories, challenges, victories, and practical advice while reminding parents that they are not alone. At its heart, Gigi’s Gift is about finding the beauty, strength, and unexpected gifts that come with a different kind of journey

title: Signal/Status
author: Signal/Status
description: Signal & Status explores the invisible forces that determine who gets heard, trusted, promoted, and remembered. Through original long-form audio episodes, we examine workplace psychology, powerful communication, quiet confidence, negotiation, social intelligence, and the unwritten rules of professional life. New episodes every week.

description: New performances and chat about Jazz and Great American Songbook Standards in the Public Domain. Special focus on the role of Central Indiana creators, entrepreneurs and institutions in the development and propagation of Jazz and Popular Music in the early 20th Century.

title: Disaster Diaries
author: Andrew Kruger
description: Real stories from survivors of hurricanes, wildfires, floods, and other disasters, with practical lessons on preparedness, recovery, rebuilding, and resilience.  Hosts Evan Farmer (While You Were Out Television Show) and BuildSOS CEO, Andy Kruger interview survivors from across the United States.

title: New Orleans Pelicans Podcast
author: New Orleans Pelicans
description: Your New Orleans Pelicans Insiders will bring you inside, up-to-date information straight from the source. Jim Eichenhofer, Pelicans.com writer, and Gus Kattengell will come through your speakers 3x a week to give you the very latest on Pelicans NBA basketball.

title: The Soul Gym
author: Soul Gym Sisters
description: The Soul Gym is the place to train your mind and transform your life. Faulty thinking can sabotage our health, wealth, and relationships. Discover how to tone up flabby thinking and develop Mental Muscle. Learn to exercise healthy thinking and live happier, healthier, and more prosperous.

title: ReMarkable

description:
Welcome to ReMarkable. 
We interview the executives, entrepreneurs, and everyday legends who built careers on their own terms by taking the unconventional path and making it work.
Hosted by Mark Gonzalez, the Forbes-recognized recruiter ranked #1 of 10,000 at Robert Half.
Every week:
	•	Unfiltered career strategy
	•	Insider recruiting secrets no one tells you
	•	AI and the future of work
	•	High-performance mindset
The career you want is one bold move away. Real stories. Real people. 
Remarkable impact. New episodes weekly.

title: Deep Dive
author: Jay Grant
description: Deep Dive offers insight into operational programs and documents available to INTERPORTPOLICE  - International Association of Airport and Seaport Police member authorities.  Established in 1968 by airport and seaport authorities from five countries, it now works with transportation authorities worldwide.  The organization holds consultative status with two United Nations agencies and is cited in U.S. federal law for training; its mission is to work collaboratively for public safety.   Copyright 2026; all rights reserved.

title: TrueLife: After Dark
author: George Monty
description:
TrueLife: After Dark is the fictional shadow of TrueLife: an anthology of short fiction, audio drama, speculative storytelling, psychedelic noir, psychological horror, science fiction, surrealism, and stories from the edges of consciousness.

Created by George Monty, After Dark explores a recurring territory: consciousness → perception → altered states → identity → transformation → reality. Across different fictional worlds, stories examine what happens when ordinary reality becomes unstable and the boundaries between mind, body, technology, spirituality, memory, mythology, and the unknown begin to blur.

Season One — The Chrysalis Compound is a serialized psychedelic fiction story about transformation, identity, altered perception, consciousness, and becoming. Start with Episode 1 and listen in order.

Season Two — The Pharmacopoeia is an anthology of fictional psychedelic compounds and the altered states, experiments, perceptions, and realities associated with them. Each episode introduces a distinct fictional compound or conceptual doorway.

Season Three — Night Priests of the Casino is psychedelic noir set inside the strange hours of a casino, exploring gambling, addiction, obsession, mysticism, grief, fate, altered states, supernatural dread, and liminal spaces.

The After Dark semantic map: psychedelic fiction, consciousness, altered states, perception, identity, transformation, reality, speculative fiction, audio drama, psychological horror, surrealism, mythology, mysticism, addiction, obsession, liminal spaces, fictional psychedelics, experimental storytelling, science fiction, noir.

New fictional series and seasons will expand the universe. Every story is fiction; fictional compounds, characters, events, and supernatural elements are imagined.

title: Chris Mikkelson Uncut
author: Evangelist Chris Mikkelson
description: Welcome to Chris Mikkelson Uncut podcast with Evangelist Chris Mikkelson. Chris Mikkelson is a mass-crusade evangelist who preaches the gospel in some of the most unreached and dangerous places on the planet. Through these crusades, millions of people hear the gospel and countless miracles happen. On the Chris Mikkelson Uncut podcast, we're talking about everything political, cultural and spiritual all from a biblical perspective. The podcast will equip, empower, and inspire you, so join us weekly on Chris Mikkelson Uncut!

title: FLASHBULB

description: Flashbulb is a documentary-style true crime podcast exploring life, death, and legacy. This series contains discussions of death, suicide, domestic violence, substance use, and child custody. Listener discretion is advised.

title: Dakdekker Medemblik
author: Dakdekker Medemblik
description: Welkom bij de podcast van Dakdekker Medemblik, dé plek voor praktische informatie en deskundige tips over daken en dakonderhoud. Als ervaren lokaal dakdekkersbedrijf bespreken we onderwerpen zoals dakreparatie, dakrenovatie, dakinspectie, lekkages, dakbedekking en preventief onderhoud. Onze afleveringen helpen huiseigenaren en bedrijven om hun dak in goede conditie te houden en problemen vroegtijdig te herkennen. We delen nuttige inzichten over verschillende soorten daken, materialen en duurzame oplossingen. Met Dakdekker Medemblik blijf je op de hoogte van belangrijke aandachtspunten rondom jouw dak. title: Little Sleepers, Big Dreamers
author: Derek Moran
description:
Little Sleepers, Big Dreamers is a nightly invitation for children to enter a world of wonder, calm and confidence. Each episode combines heartwarming bedtime stories with gentle affirmations, creating an ideal wind-down ritual for young minds and big imaginations.
From magical adventures to reassuring words of encouragement, this podcast helps children drift off feeling safe, loved and ready to dream big. With soothing sounds and inspiring tales, Little Sleepers, Big Dreamers offers more than just a bedtime story it’s a peaceful journey to dreamland and a daily boost of self-belief to carry into tomorrow.
If you and your little sleeper enjoy what you hear, don’t forget to like, subscribe and leave a review to help us reach more dreamers out there! 
Little Sleepers, Big Dreamers is available wherever you get your podcasts.

title: The Whole Conversation with Claire
author: Claire Mason
description:
The Whole Conversation is a PurposeFit Podcast hosted by Claire Mason—leadership consultant, coach, speaker, author, and founder of PurposeFit. 

Every meaningful transformation begins with an honest conversation. 

Rooted in Christian faith and viewed through a biblical perspective, The Whole Conversation brings together voices across generations and diverse life experiences to explore the conversations that shape our faith, leadership, wellness, careers, relationships, and purpose. 

Through authentic conversations, thought-provoking interviews, and practical insights, Claire creates a welcoming space for wholistic transformation—helping people across generations and walks of life grow in faith, discover their purpose, lead with integrity, and become the person God created them to be. 

Whether you're navigating a career transition, strengthening your relationship with God, pursuing personal growth, leading others, or seeking to live with greater intention, The Whole Conversation will challenge your thinking, encourage your heart, and equip you to become whole and live on purpose. 

Because some of life's greatest breakthroughs begin when we're willing to have the whole conversation. 

Become whole. Live on purpose.

title: EUROSCOPE
author: Anil JANGRA
description: Europe, explained through its own data. Each episode takes one story, one dataset and one honest question — then goes to the primary source, not the headlines. Regulation, money, energy, migration, technology: whatever is moving, made sense of beyond Brussels. Every figure carries its source and date. Every episode asks: “Where This Goes Wrong?” Predictions are made and scored on camera. Corrections appear next episode. Written and edited by Anil Jangra.

description: Deep dives into Sublette County, Wyoming: Board of County Commissioner (BOCC) and Planning & Zoning (P&Z) meeting Breakdowns, public meeting coverage, interviews, and special reports. Some episodes use AI narration, all are human reviewed. Full recordings at sublettematters.com.

author: Austin Leeck & Trevor Davidson
description: Winners Find Ways brings you authentic motorsports conversations with racers, builders, and industry leaders. From snowmobiles to dirt bikes, entrepreneurs to business owners—every episode proves that winners always find a way.

title: Riffing with Rick Lozano
author: Rick Lozano
description:
Life is weird. 

Might as well have a little fun with it.


Riffing with Rick Lozano is a podcast about creativity, music, work, relationships, and the strange, wonderful experience of being human. 


Through stories, observations, humor, and the occasional rabbit trail, keynote speaker and songwriter Rick Lozano riffs on what it means to pay attention, stay connected, and not take any of this too seriously.


We'll talk about big ideas, everyday moments, and the things that help us feel more alive, more connected, and a little less alone.


Because life is serious enough. We might as well have some fun while we're figuring it out.

title: ADHDing with Christ
author: Naylani Herrera
description: Ever tried to have a quiet time with God, only to end up reorganizing your closet, researching ancient history, and misplacing your coffee? Welcome to ADHDing with Christ. This is a space for the chronically distracted believer who loves Jesus deeply but struggles with standard church expectations. We dive into the chaotic, beautiful reality of navigating faith, executive dysfunction, and neurodivergence. No shame, no perfect quiet times—just real talk, biblical truth, and a lot of open tabs. Hit subscribe and let’s figure out what it looks like to follow Jesus with a brain that never shuts down.

title: Trill Crime
author: Robert Jerome Pagan
description:
Trill Crime is an investigative fiction podcast from RJPC Studios LLC exploring the people, places, crimes, records, and events that Trillberry may have forgotten.
Hosted by M.J.—Maya Jones, better known around town as Dr. J—the investigation begins with a disturbing contradiction: M.J. remembers growing up in Trillberry alongside two children named Jax and Leo. Old recordings prove they existed. The town remembers none of it.
Then a collection of unidentified journals is discovered hidden inside the Trillberry library.
The deeper M.J. digs, the larger the problem becomes. Missing people. Conflicting histories. Altered memories. Strange recordings. Documents that disagree with what everyone believes happened.
This isn't about proving the paranormal.
It's about following the evidence.
Because in Trillberry, memory and history are not always the same thing.
M.J. / Maya Jones is portrayed by RJPC Studios LLC resident artist Dr. Jen Self.
An RJPC Studios LLC Original.

title: From Promise to Fulfillment
author: Restoration Church of Sanford
description: From Promise to Fulfillment, hosted by Pastor Arthur Gonçalves, is a five minute biblical theology podcast that walks through the Bible one chapter at a time, from Genesis to Revelation. Each episode traces the unfolding story of redemption, highlighting key themes such as God’s kingdom, His covenants, and the promise of a coming Savior. With Scripture as the foundation and Christ at the center, this podcast helps everyday readers understand how every chapter fits into God’s redemptive plan so they can read their Bibles with greater clarity, confidence, and hope.
